OPPO F29 5G launch

Influencer campaign · Consumer tech
Challenge
OPPO’s F29 5G launch needed real reach inside a beauty-meets-tech audience, not another paid banner nobody remembers.
What we did
We matched OPPO with @arnicadqueen, a creator whose audience crosses beauty, fashion and tech, and ran one sponsored Reel for the launch.
524Kviews on the Reel, verified live on her profile
101Kfollowers on the creator’s account

Sri Sai Convention Hall

Performance marketing · Wedding and function hall, Jayanagar
Challenge
A function hall needed enquiries, not awareness. Every lead had to be tracked back to the rupee spent.
What we did
We ran Google Ads and Meta Lead Ads side by side and optimised only for cost per lead across both.
736leads in total, Google and Meta combined
₹13.04cost per lead on Meta, against ₹683.72 on Google (about 52× cheaper)

Divine Home India

Brand from scratch · Home décor, Delhi
Challenge
A Delhi décor label needed a working B2B sales pipeline from zero: three months, offline only, no existing brand presence.
What we did
We built the brand from scratch and pointed every conversation at closing wholesale and direct-buyer deals, not at growing followers.
₹30LB2B deal closed within three months, offline only
₹80Lpipeline we are targeting by Diwali

Franchise Business Solution

Paid ads and funnels · Franchise consulting
What we did
We built a paid-ads and funnel system for a franchise consulting business, starting from zero.
